info.title: KB Candidates Tool (pgvector + Cohere rerank)
info.description: Azure-native replacement for the AI Search retrieval tool: text-embedding-3-small + pgvector hybrid (vector + Postgres full-text, RRF-fused) with Cohere Rerank v4 (cosine fallback). Same get_kb_candidates contract as before: returns a single best KB match when confident, otherwise asks the agent to gather one more detail. Scores are on a 0..1 scale.

post.summary: Find the best-matching Outlook KB article for an issue or how-to
post.description: Call this at the start of triage and again after every user follow-up answer, always passing the FULL cumulative description and the SAME session_id for the whole conversation (the session_id lets the tool cap follow-up rounds). Read the response fields in this order to decide what to do: (1) followup_required=true means ask ONE more question, then call again with an updated description — if discriminating_symptoms is non-empty, ground the question ONLY in those symptoms; if it is empty, ask one focused Outlook question from your own knowledge. (2) followup_required=false with a kb_id means a confident match was found — present that article and stop. (3) followup_required=false with kb_id=null means no sufficiently confident match — hand off / close. Never invent a kb_id; only ever use the kb_id this tool returned.

description.description: The user's full Outlook issue or how-to description — the original report plus every follow-up answer received so far, concatenated into one clean sentence. Do not include greetings, off-topic text, device type, or dates.

session_id.description: A stable conversation id. Use the SAME value for every call in one conversation so the tool can count follow-up rounds and conclude after the limit. Omit only if you cannot track a conversation id.

200.description: Routing decision plus the matched KB id (when confident) or discriminating symptoms (when a follow-up is needed).

followup_required.description: true = ask one more question and call again; false = done (resolve or no-match).

kb_id.description: The matched KB article id (e.g. KB0015622) when followup_required=false and a confident match exists; null when concluded with no match. Absent while followup_required=true.

top_score.description: Match confidence of the top candidate on a 0..1 scale.

discriminating_symptoms.description: When followup_required=true, the symptom phrases to ground the next question in. May be an empty array, meaning no usable symptoms — ask your own focused Outlook follow-up instead.

message.description: A short hint about what to do next (present, ask freeform, or conclude). The structured fields above are authoritative; this is guidance.

401.description: Invalid or missing API key (only when REQUIRE_API_KEY=true)
